Browser journeys: 20/20 passed.
Requirements: 14 demonstrated, 0 failed, 6 unverified.

criteria.requirement: Offline-first with clean sync
criteria.detail: All three synthetic forms and tasking outputs are saved offline, survive reload, route locally after review, and reach an acknowledged local demo replica after explicit conflict resolution. No real sync is claimed. — demonstrated by forms-route, tasking-records, conflict-review, save-recovery at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Human review before anything is submitted
criteria.detail: Invalid, unsaved, conflicted and changed revisions cannot route; explicit review of the saved current revision precedes each local route. A changed approved duration requires renewed review. — demonstrated by validation-recovery, conflict-review at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Audit trail
criteria.detail: Audit export and review/routing ledger retain source-linked immutable revision actions, Training Reviewer decisions, reasons and local routing/receipt states. — demonstrated by evaluation-exports, conflict-review at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Runs on government devices and existing low-code platforms where possible
criteria.detail: Authorized government device/browser policy and owner-selected low-code runtime are required to establish actual compatibility. Synthetic desktop/narrow workflow, reload and exports are demonstrated; they cannot certify those systems.

criteria.requirement: Synthetic data only; no personal information
criteria.detail: The application and exports use fictional DEMO records, no personal information, and visible synthetic/nonoperational labels; pause blocks routing and acknowledgement. — demonstrated by safety-stop, forms-route, evaluation-exports at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Fleet-Ready Definition of Done (all solutions): runs offline; keeps humans in authority; cites sources; logs auditable actions; syncs on reconnect; includes a one-page path to fleet.
criteria.detail: Labeled synthetic workflow operates from the local file offline with citations, reviewed routing, inspectable audit, simulated reconnect and a downloadable one-page path to fleet. This is not operational Fleet-Ready certification. — demonstrated by forms-route, tasking-records, conflict-review, evaluation-exports at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Replaying an operation has no duplicate effect.
criteria.detail: Replaying immutable operations adds zero revisions and zero duplicate routing effects. — demonstrated by replay-converge at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Concurrent edits and deletes remain visible.
criteria.detail: Concurrent edit/edit values 45 and 50 and edit/delete heads remain visible until a reasoned reviewer choice creates a new revision referencing every reviewed head. — demonstrated by replay-converge, conflict-review at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Converge independent of delivery order.
criteria.detail: Opposite delivery orders yield identical canonical record state with both concurrent heads preserved. Missing history preserves the queue until restored. — demonstrated by replay-converge, missing-history at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Resume transfers within a bounded link budget.
criteria.detail: Zero budget retains work; send without acknowledgement leaves image at 6144 bytes; acknowledged 4096-byte budget sends critical 1024 and image 3072, reaching 9216; next 3072 completes 12288 after reload. — demonstrated by transfer-resume at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Persist across device restart and review before routing.
criteria.detail: Saved edits and acknowledged offsets survive browser reload offline; reconnect conflicts require explicit choice and renewed review before routing, with reviewer decision exported. Physical restart, eviction and device loss remain unverified. — demonstrated by forms-route, save-recovery, conflict-review, transfer-resume at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Extraction accuracy against an answer key
criteria.detail: Against the planner-defined 20-field synthetic answer key, raw extraction is 16/20 (80%); after source-based correction reviewed accuracy is 20/20 (100%). No general OCR or real-data accuracy is claimed. — demonstrated by evaluation-exports, tasking-records at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Errors caught before submission
criteria.detail: All four seeded issues (ambiguous duration, negative quantity, missing subject, conflicting task due date) block routing, survive correction, and result in 4 caught, 4 corrected and 0 unresolved before approval. — demonstrated by validation-recovery, evaluation-exports at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Time per packet against a manual baseline [baseline to be set with Fleet SME]
criteria.detail: A Fleet SME must authorize the official manual baseline; synthetic elapsed timing, assumed 1200-second comparison and arithmetic cannot establish that authorized comparison.

criteria.requirement: Complete offline operation and conflict-free sync
criteria.detail: Both synthetic tracks complete offline, survive reload, resolve competing heads explicitly and acknowledge the reviewed local packet on simulated reconnect without duplicate effects. No operational transport is implied. — demonstrated by forms-route, tasking-records, conflict-review, replay-converge at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Ease of use judged by a Sailor panel
criteria.detail: An actual Sailor panel must judge usability. Complete task flows and an unscored panel worksheet are demonstrated; software cannot supply panel judgment.

criteria.requirement: Official judging rubric: Warfighting 30%; Speed to Fleet 20%; Scalability 20%; Barrier Removal 15%; Judges' Discretion 15%.
criteria.detail: Official judges must assign the rubric scores. A worksheet with exact categories/weights and blank scores is demonstrated; it cannot confer official scores.

criteria.requirement: Sailor hours returned to maintenance, training and watchstanding
criteria.detail: Observed unit workload and time-use data are needed to establish hours actually returned. Measured prototype timing and fictional 20-packet illustrative savings cannot establish realized benefit.

criteria.requirement: Fewer errors and less rework
criteria.detail: Comparable unit baseline and follow-up error/rework observations are needed to establish actual reductions. Four seeded issues caught/corrected demonstrate synthetic prevention, not operational improvement.

criteria.requirement: Forms completed and routed without connectivity
criteria.detail: Completed training log, supply requisition and routine correspondence/routing cover sheet are downloadable and routed to a named local demo queue while offline, clearly pending sync. — demonstrated by forms-route at both viewport sizes.
